705410102.text: Awww, that's a good kitty, Sir Pouncelot!

705410103.text: You better be on your best behavior from now on, okay? Don't go causing trouble now. Hehe, Paimon knows you're a sweet, happy little cat. You'll get along with everyone just fine.

705410104.text: He's so adorable! I just wanna scratch his head and pinch his little cheeks!

705410105.text: He does have a certain endearing quality about him... when he's not causing trouble, that is. Hmm, I wonder how he got that injury around his eye...

705410106.text: The traces of the restorative potion indicate that Sir Pouncelot should be in the vicinity.

705410107.text: #Oh, it's {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Sister Rosaria... Ah, and you must be an adventurer. I don't believe we've met...

705410108.text: It appears Sir Pouncelot has taken quite the liking to you.

705410109.text: Albedo! It's been such a long time! It's super great to see you! But... are you sure you're in the right place?

705410110.text: I'm assuming the Captain of the Investigation Team is here for some important reason?

705410111.text: C—Captain? He's a captain of the Knights of Favonius? An important officer just showed up without warning... and I don't even have any refreshments or snacks to offer!

705410112.text: Please, allow me to explain, Sir. I assure you this shelter is operating under a legitimate business license! All proper procedures have been followed...

705410113.text: Assuming that Albedo has arrived to investigate her business, Valerina frantically searches for the relevant documents while explaining the purpose of the shelter...\n Valerina appears intimidated by the identity of the visitor, unaware that the Investigation Team doesn't handle such inspections...

705410114.text: There's no need to worry. I was simply in the area helping my team address a small issue... Namely, the location of this cat right here.

705410115.text: Not too long ago, "Interim Team Feline: Treatment Case No. 3 — Sir Pouncelot" knocked out the weapons officer who was watching over him. He then fled and disappeared into the city.

705410116.text: We knew we had to recover him as fast as possible. The cat belongs to the Investigation Team, and even bears the insignia of the Knights of Favonius. If he were to wreak havoc across the city... Well, that would hardly be a welcome result for any party involved.

705410120.text: You're saying Sir Pouncelot is capable of knocking out a knight? And what's with all those official sounding titles you added to his name? Interim... Treatment case something or other... Is there something else you're not telling us?

705410121.text: Ah, well, I suppose I should explain. Two months ago, Sir Pouncelot got lost in the wild and accidentally ingested Whopperflower Nectar. Due to certain effects that are not entirely understood as of yet, the nectar caused him to triple in size.

705410122.text: Triple! Even regular-sized cats can get pretty bold when they're upset... A cat triple the size... Paimon bets even a Hilichurl wouldn't be enough to scare off a cat like that!

705410123.text: So that's what happened. No wonder he was so anxious.

705410124.text: For cats... or really any animal that lives in the wild, a larger size doesn't exactly confer many advantages. What it actually does is make their appearance more noticeable and their movements less nimble.

705410125.text: Which, in turn, means living in perpetual danger of exposing themselves to attacks from predators. In other words, it means living in a constant state of fear...

705410126.text: Exactly. When Sir Pouncelot stumbled upon our encampment, he looked quite worse for wear. His entire body was riddled with scars and he appeared exceptionally anxious.

705410127.text: Th—That's awful... I guess he had a good reason for all that swatting earlier, then... If all that had happened to me, I would be afraid of new people and strange animals too...

705410128.text: You don't need to worry too much. The problem has already been solved. I administered a restorative potion to eliminate the alchemical effects of the Whopperflower Nectar, and help him return to a normal size.

705410129.text: Although he still might appear a bit larger than the average cat, his current size, at least, should pose no more threat to his quality of life. While in our care, various knights have been taking turns watching over him.

705410130.text: In light of his feisty demeanor, Klee decided to call him "Sir Pouncelot." We all thought it was quite fitting. We even made him that little scarf as a testament to his time among our ranks.

705410131.text: Woah, Klee and Paimon were totally on the same wavelength with this one! We thought of the exact same name! Great minds really do think alike, hehe...

705410133.text: Sir Pouncelot's extreme level of anxiety and caution around people may be a result of residual trauma from the time of his transformation. You could say he was less than friendly towards the weapons and signals officers on our team. Klee wasn't around that much to entertain him either.

705410134.text: However, it appears Sir Pouncelot has taken quite the liking to you. The knights on my team would never have imagined that he could warm up to people like this.

705410135.text: Well, they are our dear cat saviors, after all — The famed Honorary Knight and Paimon the Cat Whisperer!

705410136.text: #No matter how feisty or frightening the cat, after a few minutes with {NICKNAME} and Paimon, they'll be sweet as can be!

705410137.text: If that's the case, then I have a question for you both. Would you be willing to adopt Sir Pouncelot?

705410138.text: Wait, really? But, doesn't he belong to your team?

705410139.text: Well, we did take him in, but it was simply out of necessity. We were always planning to find him a permanent home after his condition became more stable.

705410140.text: The Investigation Team is no place for a pet, and we are a combat unit, after all.

705410141.text: Any knight he got close to would have to go on assignment eventually. It's hardly appropriate to just leave him at camp, and bringing him on our missions would only frighten him further.

705410143.text: He's been through quite the ordeal already. For a creature like that, it's best to keep him away from potential triggers. That way, he can slowly recover in peace...

705410144.text: Hmm, we could set up a nice, cozy little home for him in the Serenitea Pot. It has everything he could want! And most importantly... no monsters!
